text:
maya: Quick heads-up — we should align on a staggered upgrade for the next ship window. Propose schedule: API server (minor) Wed 09:00 PT, inference-runtime (patch -> maybe minor?) Wed 09:30 PT, console-web + js-sdk follow-on at 10:00 PT. Can everyone confirm blockers? :eyes:

jordan: I can land console shims today. One note: console needs a minor version bump because of the header rename to `x-rw-route`. Will open PR in ~30m.

sam: Runtime: there's a performance hotfix that was intended as a patch, but the KV header rename is breaking for older runtimes. I'm leaning minor for runtime so we don't have to do a hotfix dance. Will attach compatibility matrix in the PR.

lee: API team: minor is fine, change is additive for the admin endpoints. I'll tag and cut release branches after we merge. Plan to run integration tests against the inference-runtime tag before cutting.

ana: js-sdk: we have a one-line client change for header mapping; patch is fine from our side but if console goes minor we might need to publish a minor too for semver compatibility. Triage: patch ok if console exposes a compatibility shim.

maya: Good call. Let's avoid simultaneous major-ish bumps. Proposal: make runtime minor, api minor, console minor, js-sdk patch with compatibility shim. Stagger windows so runtime upgrade happens before client libraries publish.

jordan: I'll push the shim and a CI job to run integrated smoke tests: `./scripts/integration.sh --target console --api-tag v0.19.x --runtime-tag v1.4.x`. Putting that in the PR description.

sam: CI note: current runtime branch has a failing test on seqcache. Fix incoming, but expect ~45m. I'll ping when green.

ci-bot: [build/sequence] runtime/unit-tests #489 failed (seqcache.test.js) — details: https://ci.internal/r/489

sam: Fixed and force-pushed. ci-bot: [build/sequence] runtime/unit-tests #490 passed ✅

maya: Nice. Quick checklist before cut: 
- confirm changelog entries for each repo (short bullet + author)
- ensure compatibility shims live in console until clients pick up patch
- cut release branches in the order: runtime -> api -> console -> js-sdk
- notify infra to monitor burst GPU usage for the runtime rollout window

lee: I'll add a changelog PR template comment with the required bullets. Also pinging @ops-bot for monitoring.

ops-bot: Infra alerting scheduled for Wed 09:00-11:00 PT. Monitoring playbook: /playbooks/release-rollout.md (runbook updated).

ana: Timeline check: if runtime cut at 09:30 and api at 09:00, how do we verify integrated behaviour? Would prefer api cut first, runtime second, then wait 15m for smoke.

maya: Agree — reorder: API 09:00, runtime 09:30, 15m smoke, console 10:00, js-sdk 10:15. That gives rollback windows.

jordan: Sounds good. I'll mark PRs with `release/ready` label once changelogs are in and ci is green.

sam: Will post runtime tag names here after the cut. Expecting `v1.4.2` (minor bump from v1.3.x).

lee: API will be `v0.19.0` (minor). Console likely `v0.45.0` if all goes well. js-sdk patch `v0.12.3`.

maya: Two small asks: 1) if you touch client-facing shape, add a brief note in CHANGELOG.md under "compatibility notes"; 2) whoever cuts a tag run `./scripts/verify-release.sh --smoke` and paste output in this thread.

jordan: Will do. Example smoke command I'll paste in PRs: ```bash
./scripts/verify-release.sh --api https://staging.api.redwood --token $TOKEN --smoke
```

sam: runtime smoke passed locally: `smoke: ok (latency 48ms, p50 40ms)`. Will run infra job after the cut.

ci-bot: [release-gate] All repos with label `release/ready` at 08:45 PT: console, api, js-sdk (runtime pending).

maya: If anyone expects to miss the window, call it out now. Otherwise we'll proceed with the staged plan. :shipit:

lee: On my side it's green. Changelog PR: https://git.internal/console/pulls/1324 (waiting on review).

jordan: Console PR opened: https://git.internal/console/pulls/1325 — includes shim and changelog.

sam: Runtime PR #678 pushed. Sequence tests passed. Tagging when we merge.

maya: Okay team — final: api cut 09:00 PT (lee), runtime cut 09:30 PT (sam), 09:45-10:00 smoke, console publish 10:00 (jordan), js-sdk 10:15 (ana). Post status updates here with `verify-release` output.

ana: Will publish js-sdk once console is live. Will paste npm dist-tag and the `npm publish` output here.

sam: runtime tag pushed: `v1.4.2` — smoke: `ok` — infra verified GPU load stable.

ci-bot: [deploy] runtime v1.4.2 deployed to staging — all checks passed.

lee: API tag pushed: `v0.19.0` — integration tests green.

jordan: Console published `v0.45.0` and shim will remain for two releases. npm: `+ console@0.45.0`

ana: js-sdk published `v0.12.3` (patch) — npm dist-tag `latest` moved.

maya: Excellent. Last item: I'll open a short post-release note in the release channel summarizing the changelogs and any action items for next week (rollback lessons, telemetry checks). Thanks all. :tada:

lee: Thanks — great coordination. (reacted :thumbsup:)
